classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Find and analyze representative sequences for NAD(P)HX repair proteins with ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase (GO:0070143) and NADPHX epimerase (GO:0070144) activity, supplemented by InterPro family IPR023087, run sequence-level profiling on each retrieved set, and rank representative candidates by sequence-based quality metrics.
assumptions: GO:0070143 corresponds to ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity and GO:0070144 to NADPHX epimerase activity; if either term is absent or remapped in the current UniProt-GOA release the corresponding fetch node will return an empty FASTA and downstream analysis for that branch will be skipped.

IPR023087 is used as the NAD(P)HX repair protein family entry; it may cover primarily the dehydratase (NNRD) subfamily — a second interpro_sequences call for a distinct NNRE epimerase domain entry would further expand coverage but its specific IPR accession was not available.
Workflow is restricted to Swiss-Prot reviewed entries (reviewed=true) to maximise annotation quality; broadening to TrEMBL can be done by setting reviewed=null at runtime.
IEA (electronically inferred) GO annotations are excluded (exclude_iea=true) on the GO fetch nodes to reduce annotation noise.

No MMseqs2-formatted target database path is available so mmseqs2_gpu clustering is omitted; representativeness is approximated from sequence_analysis diversity and compositional metrics rather than an explicit sequence-identity clustering step.
No experimental or predicted structure files are available at this stage; ranking proceeds on sequence-level features only (composition, charge, motifs, per-residue biochemical annotations).
Sequences returned by the three fetch nodes may overlap by accession; rank_designs is expected to merge and de-duplicate across the union of candidates and analysis records.
missing_inputs: MMseqs2-formatted target database path required by mmseqs2_gpu to perform explicit sequence-identity-based redundancy reduction — mmseqs2_gpu node omitted from workflow until this path is supplied.

success_criteria.sequences_retrieved: At least one non-empty FASTA returned from fetch_dehydratase, fetch_epimerase, or fetch_interpro.
success_criteria.analyses_complete: sequence_analysis records produced for every non-empty retrieved FASTA set covering composition, charge at pH 7.4, region annotations, and per-residue biochemical table.
success_criteria.ranked_output: rank_designs produces a scored, descending-order list of up to 20 representative NAD(P)HX repair protein candidates with merged sequence-analysis annotations from all three retrieval branches.
